items.headline: SoftBank weighs $10-20B bond sale as existing notes sell off, racing to refinance $40B OpenAI bridge loan
items.note: SoftBank's existing 8.5% 2036 notes fell ~2.5c on reports it may sell up to $20B in new dollar/euro bonds (its first 144A deal in a decade) to refinance the $40B bridge loan backing its OpenAI stake — a forced-refinancing stress sign in the AI shadow-financing chain.

items.headline: SoftBank plans record ¥1 trillion ($6.3B) retail bond sale to keep funding its OpenAI commitments
items.note: Biggest-ever retail bond offering by a Japanese issuer, layered on top of the $40B OpenAI bridge loan and the mulled institutional deal — notable leverage buildup at the entity most exposed to OpenAI's private valuation, not yet a distress signal.
